title: The Postcard of Port Alder
author: Mirabel Lockridge
blurb: Jude Quintana, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
